web_title: 7. Why the Price Is What It Is: Valuation, Diluted Reverse DCF & Peer Comps
book_title: Chapter 7: Why the Stock Trades Here — Diluted Value, Stress Matrix & Peers
question: What growth, margin, dilution, and multiple normalization is priced into IGIL at ₹432.50 (2026-11-25 live TradingView close) versus ₹431.10 (2026-11-23 NSE ledger close), and how does it compare with listed jewelry peers?

epigraph.quote: Price is what you pay; value is what you get. When an asset-light toll-booth earns 69% ROCE, the market rarely puts it on clearance—your edge comes from pricing dilution, institutional outflows, and multiple compression honestly before buying.
epigraph.author: Institutional Valuation Desk

web_blocks.title: Deconstructing Today's Price Across Verified Market Feeds

web_blocks.html: We track two clear session cutoffs so every price stays auditable. On the 2026-11-23 NSE market-facts ledger, IGIL closed at ₹431.10. On the 2026-11-25 live TradingView and Screener snapshot, shares closed at ₹432.50 (+0.32% daily, -4.31% weekly). That sets market cap at ₹18,632.57 Cr on TradingView and ₹18,691 Cr on Screener across ~43.22 Cr basic shares [1][43].

At ₹432.50 (2026-11-25 live close), IGIL trades at 29.05x TradingView trailing P/E (28.1x Screener P/E). Price-to-Book stands at 10.67x on ₹40.50 book value, with a 0.59% dividend yield [1][43]. Subtracting ₹1,074.9 Cr in September 2026 cash and adding lease liabilities (zero bank debt; 0.09x Debt-to-Equity) puts Enterprise Value near ₹17,650 Cr [30][43]. On the surface, a sub-30x multiple looks modest for 69.2% ROCE, 55.8% ROE, and 57.7%–61.4% operating margins [1][30].

Six verified frictions explain why the market refuses to pay 45x–60x retail multiples. First, Blackstone owns 76.55% and must drop below 75% by December 2027 under SEBI rules, guaranteeing secondary supply [1][26]. Second, Screener shareholding data shows steady institutional selling ahead of that overhang: FIIs fell from 10.55% (Sep 2025) to 8.79% (Sep 2026, -176 bps), DIIs fell from 6.38% (Mar 2026) to 5.47% (-91 bps), and retail float climbed +142 bps to 9.17% [1][43]. Third, Note 47 discloses 19.55 million active ESOP 2024 options (~4.52% dilution; 60% tied to sponsor exits) [32][39]. Fourth, India standalone EBITDA margin dipped 340 bps YoY to 69.5% in Q2 FY27 without standalone ex-AGL LGD ASP or commission disclosures [30][40]. Fifth, the 10% U.S. Section 301 diamond tariff (July 2026) strained Surat cutters right after IGIL cut ECL reserves to 1.82% [34][35][39]. Sixth, AI rival GCAL by Sarine opened a Mumbai SEEPZ jewelry lab [36][37].

web_blocks.title: Diluted Reverse DCF, Earnings Quality & Multiple-Compression Stress Matrix

web_blocks.html: We model IGIL strictly on a fully diluted basis and normalize earnings quality. Adding 19.55 million ESOP 2024 options (~4.52% dilution) to ~43.22 Cr basic shares lifts our share count to 45.18 Cr diluted shares [32][39]. Two quality caveats also temper headline Q2 FY27 PAT (₹186 Cr): effective tax fell to a 12-quarter-low 24% versus the ~27% audited average (~₹6.4 Cr boost), and TTM treasury Other Income contributed ₹64 Cr (7.2% of ₹895 Cr PBT) [1][30]. On Screener's ~₹665 Cr trailing PAT (TradingView ~₹641 Cr), diluted trailing EPS sits at ₹14.20–₹14.72 (29.4x–30.5x diluted TTM P/E at ₹432.50) [1][43].

Inverting today's ~₹17,650 Cr Enterprise Value (11.0% cost of equity, 5.0% terminal growth, ~₹580 Cr normalized FCF backed by ₹415.7 Cr H1 OCF) shows ₹432.50 prices 13.0%–14.5% annual FCF compounding for ten years at 53%–56% margins [30][43]. Because FII and DII holdings have fallen while Blackstone faces a mandatory pre-December 2027 MPS sell-down, assuming zero multiple compression as post-GIA growth slows from ~27% in FY27 to low-teens (~13%) in FY28 is too aggressive. We therefore trim our Base Target further—from ₹500.00 to ₹480.00 (27.1x diluted FY28E EPS of ₹17.71 on ₹800 Cr PAT at normalized 27% tax). The two tables below present our three core scenarios and a 22x–28x P/E versus 54%–58% OPM stress matrix.

web_blocks.takeaway: Accounting for 4.52% ESOP dilution, FII/DII outflows, and modest post-GIA multiple normalization under Blackstone's MPS overhang trims our Base Target to ₹480.00 (27.1x FY28E diluted EPS; Probability-Weighted EV ₹461.25).

web_blocks.html: To test downside before a full Bear collapse, we cross-tabulate exit diluted P/E (22.0x to 28.2x) against consolidated OPM (54.0% to 58.0%) and partial ECL reversion at an audited 27% tax rate. If OPM slips 400 bps to 54.0% and ECL reverts halfway to 4.50% (₹7.88 Cr credit cost on ₹293.9 Cr gross receivables), FY28E PAT drops to ₹739.08 Cr (₹16.36 diluted EPS). At 22.0x overhang P/E, fair value falls to ₹359.89 (-16.8% vs. live ₹432.50)—proving why chasing above ₹395 leaves zero margin of safety.

web_blocks.takeaway: Even without a full Bear collapse, compressing exit P/E to 22.0x values Base EPS at ₹389.62 (-9.9%) and 54%-OPM stressed EPS at ₹359.89 (-16.8%)—justifying a tightened ₹380.00–₹395.00 entry zone.

web_blocks.title: Peer Comparison: Listed Indian Jewelry Ecosystem Benchmarks

web_blocks.html: IGIL has no pure-play listed lab peer in India. GIA and HRD Antwerp are non-profits, while GCAL parent Sarine Technologies trades in Singapore on loss-making hardware results ($14.4 million H1 sales; $3.49 million net loss) [38]. We benchmark IGIL against four listed Indian jewelry peers from our 2026-11-25 live TradingView and Screener snapshot: Titan (TITAN), Kalyan Jewellers (KALYANKJIL), Senco Gold (SENCO), and Vaibhav Global (VAIBHAVGBL) [19][20][43][44][45]. We also list 2026-11-23 NSE ledger closes side by side where available.

web_blocks.caption: IGIL vs. Listed Indian Jewelry Ecosystem Peers (Live 2026-11-25 TradingView/Screener Snapshot vs. 2026-11-23 NSE Ledger)
web_blocks.takeaway: IGIL earns over triple the ROCE (69.2%) and five to ten times the margin (57.7%) of jewelry retailers while trading at half Titan's P/E (29.05x vs. 59.14x) and a 29% discount to Kalyan Jewellers (41.10x).

web_blocks.html: The peer gap highlights IGIL's superior model. Retailers TITAN (59.14x TV P/E, 10.1% OPM, 20.5% ROCE, 2.19x D/E) and KALYANKJIL (41.10x P/E, 5.5% OPM, 21.2% ROCE, 0.92x D/E) fund heavy store inventory [19][20][43]. Smaller peers SENCO (8.45x P/E) and VAIBHAVGBL (9.48x P/E) sit in Stage 4 downtrends under tariff and margin pressure [44][45]. IGIL holds zero stone inventory and ₹1,074.9 Cr cash with zero bank debt. Yet its 29.05x multiple reflects caution over LGD pricing, Surat credit (ECL cut to 1.82%), FII/DII outflows, and Blackstone's pending MPS sales [1][30][39].

Valuation Trigger: Raise Base Target above ₹520 if ex-AGL revenue per report stays flat YoY through Q4 FY27, India standalone margin holds above 68%, and FII/DII ownership stabilizes above 14.3% through Blackstone's first block. Cut fair value toward ₹300 if ASP drops over 10% YoY, consolidated OPM falls under 50%, or ECL spikes above 6%.

web_blocks.title: VALUATION TAKEAWAY: QUALITY AT A FAIR MULTIPLE, STRESS-ADJUSTED TO ₹480
paragraphs: Charging 4.52% ESOP dilution, FII/DII outflows, normalized 27% taxes, and modest MPS multiple compression trims our Base Target to ₹480.00 (27.1x FY28E diluted EPS ₹17.71; EV ₹461.25). At live ₹432.50, upside is just +11.0% against -19.1% risk to ₹349.83 (0.57:1 R:R). Waiting for ₹380.00–₹395.00 is mandatory.

book_paragraphs: Once our Pass 1 blind audit is locked—confirming that International Gemological Institute remains a Compounder Pass with 69.2% return on capital, ₹1,074.9 crore in cash, and zero bank debt, yet carries clear governance and margin watchpoints—we unlock the market screen. Keeping both session cutoffs distinct keeps our math honest. On the November 23, 2026 NSE market-facts ledger, IGIL closed at ₹431.10. Two sessions later, on our November 25, 2026 live TradingView and Screener snapshot, shares settled at ₹432.50, valuing the business at ₹18,633 crore on TradingView and ₹18,691 crore on Screener.

At ₹432.50, IGIL trades at 29.05 times TradingView trailing earnings, or 28.1 times on Screener, with a price-to-book ratio of 10.67 times. Ask yourself why a debt-free global toll-booth growing top-line sales at 31% trades at 29 times earnings while Titan commands 59 times and Kalyan Jewellers fetches 41 times. The market is pricing six real-world frictions: Blackstone's mandatory sell-down from 76.55% before December 2027, visible institutional selling (FIIs fell 176 basis points from 10.55% to 8.79% and DIIs slipped 91 basis points from 6.38% to 5.47% while retail absorbed +142 basis points to 9.17%), 19.55 million ESOP 2024 options (4.52% dilution), India standalone's 340-basis-point margin dip to 69.5%, the 10% U.S. Section 301 diamond tariff hitting Surat cutters just as ECL reserves dropped to 1.82%, and GCAL by Sarine's new Mumbai SEEPZ lab.

book_subsections.title: Charging Dilution, Taxes, and Multiple Normalization Honestly
paragraphs: Honest valuation never extrapolates peak margins or ignores shareholder outflows. First, adding Note 47's 19.55 million ESOP 2024 options (4.52% dilution) to 43.22 crore basic shares lifts our modeling count to 45.18 crore fully diluted shares. Second, headline Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹186 crore enjoyed a 12-quarter-low 24% effective tax rate versus IGIL's 27% historical norm (a roughly ₹6.4 crore tailwind), while ₹64 crore of TTM treasury Other Income represents 7.2% of pre-tax profit. Third, inverting today's ₹17,650 crore Enterprise Value at an 11% cost of equity and 5% terminal growth shows ₹432.50 already bakes in 13% to 14.5% annual free cash flow compounding for ten straight years.

When post-GIA profit growth naturally cools from ~27% in FY27 toward ~13% in FY28 right as Blackstone prepares to reduce its 76.55% stake into a tape where FIIs and DIIs have been net sellers, assuming zero multiple compression is wishful thinking. We therefore trim our Base Target to ₹480.00—valuing ₹800 crore of FY28E net profit (₹17.71 diluted EPS at normalized 27% tax) at 27.1 times diluted earnings, a modest two-turn compression from today's 29.05 times TradingView multiple.

callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION: STRESS-TESTING BEFORE YOU EVER CLICK BUY
callouts.text: Our moderate stress matrix shows why price discipline saves portfolios: if consolidated margins slip 400 basis points to 54%, ECL reserves revert halfway to 4.5%, and the multiple compresses to 22 times during a Blackstone block, fair value drops to ₹359.89 (-16.8% below ₹432.50). Buying only inside ₹380–₹395 puts real air between your cost basis and that downside.

book_subsections.title: Stress-Testing FY28E Across 22x–28x Multiples and 54%–58% Margins
paragraphs: Let us walk through our sensitivity matrix in plain numbers. Even if IGIL hits our full ₹800 crore Base profit (₹17.71 diluted EPS), a realistic de-rating to 22 times under sponsor supply values the stock at ₹389.62—nearly 10% below today's ₹432.50 price. Add a moderate 400-basis-point operating margin slip to 54% plus partial ECL reversion from 1.82% to 4.5% (₹7.88 crore extra credit cost) at 27% tax, and FY28E net profit drops to ₹739.1 crore (₹16.36 diluted EPS). At 28.2 times flat TTM multiples, fair value is ₹461.31; at 22 times overhang multiples, it falls to ₹359.89.

Across our three probability-weighted scenarios—Bull at ₹585.00 (25% weight, ₹860 crore PAT at 30.7x), Base at ₹480.00 (50% weight, ₹800 crore PAT at 27.1x), and Bear at ₹300.00 (25% weight, ₹650 crore PAT at 20.8x)—our 12-to-18-month expected value stands at ₹461.25. From ₹432.50, that is just 6.6% expected return against 19.1% stop-loss risk.

book_subsections.title: Stacking IGIL Against Listed Indian Jewelry Peers
paragraphs: Compare IGIL side by side against our November 25, 2026 live peer screen, and its capital-light advantage still shines brightly. Titan Company trades at ₹4,686.60 (59.14 times trailing earnings, 22.76 times book) on 10.1% operating margins, 20.5% ROCE, and 2.19 times debt-to-equity. Kalyan Jewellers trades at ₹636.35 (41.10 times earnings) on 5.5% operating margins, 21.2% ROCE, and 0.92 times leverage. Both are premier retail brands, yet every incremental rupee of jewelry sales locks up cash in gold and diamond inventory.

Meanwhile, smaller listed peers Senco Gold (₹314.00, 8.45 times earnings, 1.11 times debt-to-equity) and Vaibhav Global (₹156.43, 9.48 times earnings, 7.2% margins) sit deep in Stage 4 downtrends as tariff pressure and retail headwinds compress profits. IGIL earns 57.7% trailing operating margins and 69.2% ROCE with zero stone inventory and ₹1,074.9 crore in cash—yet still trades at less than half Titan's multiple and a 29% discount to Kalyan Jewellers.

book_subsections.title: Why Patience to ₹380–₹395 Restores Real Margin of Safety
paragraphs: Putting the peer table and our stress matrix together yields one unmistakable lesson. IGIL is an elite business trading at a fair—not cheap—multiple. Paying ₹432.50 today hands you just 11.0% upside to our ₹480.00 Base Target against 19.1% risk to our ₹349.83 structural stop, a dismal 0.57-to-1 ratio.

Let the stock pull back into ₹380.00–₹395.00, however, and you are buying right at the 22x overhang-adjusted Base value (₹389.62) with 1.88-to-1 to 3.31-to-1 Base reward-to-risk and 1.47-to-1 to 2.69-to-1 expected-value asymmetry. Valuation sets our ₹380–₹395 price fence; Chapter 8 maps the exact tape signals required to step in.
